users.bio: Senior practicing advocate specializing in High Court Constitutional Writs (Mandamus when government departments fail to act), Property Partition, and Public Law.
Practicing lawyer before National Green Tribunal (NGT), High Courts, and commercial tribunals for industrial compliance, recovery suites, and trade licenses.
Specialist in matrimonial disputes, mutual consent divorce, 125 CrPC maintenance, anticipatory bail, and Information Commission RTI 2nd appeals.

cases.folderName: RTI Second Appeal for Govt Tender Scrutiny
cases.title: Public Information Officer denied road construction tender bills citing commercial secrecy
cases.summary: PIO and First Appellate Authority denied information under Section 8(1)(d). Need Second Appeal drafting before State Information Commission to expose corrupt fund diversion.

timelineSteps.title: Notice Issued by State Info Commission

bids.briefAdvice: We will file an immediate application under Order 39 Rule 1 & 2 CPC in Jalandhar Civil Court to obtain an interim injunction halting construction within 48 hours, while concurrently moving a revenue revision under Punjab Land Revenue Act.

We will prepare an emergency petition before NGT Principal Bench challenging the violation of natural justice (Section 31A Air Act mandate). We will seek an immediate interim stay on factory closure subject to stack monitoring test.

We will draft and file a Writ Petition (Civil Misc) under Article 226 before the Lucknow Bench of Allahabad High Court praying for a Writ of Mandamus directing the DM to demolish the illegal obstruction within 2 weeks.
Under Section 8(2) RTI Act, larger public interest supersedes trade secrets in government civil road works. We have filed the 2nd Appeal and secured hearing notice.
